Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Siddhartha Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings,
including charge-sheet dated 22.06.2022 and cognizance/summoning order dated 19.07.2006, of
case no. 1872 of 2023, arising out of case crime no. 313 of 2006, under Sections 498A, 324, 504, 506
Ipc, P.S. Kotwali, District Ghaziabad, pending in the court of A.C.J.M., Court No. 6, Ghaziabad.

3.  After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he is not pressing the prayer for quashing of proceedings and instead of the same, applicant may be permitted to move an application for discharge before the trial court concerned, in accordance with law and till disposal of the discharge application, some interim protection may be granted to the applicant.

sentences.text: In view of aforesaid, the instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., is finally disposed of with direction to the trial court that in case, applicant moves an application for discharge within a period of two weeks from today, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously, in accordance with law.

For a period of two weeks from today and in case such an application is moved within the aforesaid period, till the disposal of such application, no coercive action shall be taken against applicant, provided applicant co-operates in early disposal of the discharge application.
5. The application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of in above terms.
